title: PBM AND ACTIVATED SLUDGE FLOCCULATION: FROM EXPERIMENTAL DATA TO A CALIBRATED MODEL

model_assumptions.text: No significant growth occurs during the short flocculation experiments.
model_assumptions.quote: Since the model will be used to describe rather short flocculation experiments (max. 4h), it can be assumed that no significant growth occurs ( $ \dot{X}(x,t)=0 $).

model_assumptions.text: Binary breakage is assumed, so Γ equals 2.
model_assumptions.quote: When binary breakage is assumed, which was the case in this study, Γ equals 2.
